service.name: SAVER Verifier
service.description: Verify factual claims and check whether cited sources support them. Fact-check statistics, dates and source attributions in agent research and reports against web evidence, preserving reporting periods, units and population groups. Returns a verdict, explanation and cited sources; /v2/verify links evidence to source IDs. 0.20 USDC via x402 v2 on Base. Model-assessed; no signup or API key.
